appearances.whereabouts: The Queen's Blessing inn in Caemlyn, then moving through the Inner City streets to watch the procession, finally climbing a wall to view Logain's entry
appearances.notable_actions: Tries to convince Mat to come see Logain; speaks with Master Gill about the beggar asking after them; leaves the inn and joins the crowd; sees Whitecloaks being jostled; flees when the beggar spots and points at him; searches for a vantage point to see Logain; climbs a wall and watches the procession; falls from the wall after being startled by a girl's voice
appearances.demeanor: eager, excited about seeing Logain and the procession; anxious when hearing about the beggar; frightened when the beggar points at him; determined to see the spectacle despite obstacles

appearances.whereabouts: His room at The Queen's Blessing inn
appearances.notable_actions: Refuses to leave his room; lies curled up on his bed; calls Loial a Trolloc; will only eat food brought by Rand

Meets Rand at the foot of the stairs; warns him about a beggar asking after him and his friends by name; dismisses rumors about strange shapes as Whitecloak nonsense; advises Rand to leave by the alley; expresses concern about the city's political tensions
appearances.demeanor: concerned but jovial, protective of his guests, dismissive of wild rumors

appearances.whereabouts: Two streets from The Queen's Blessing
appearances.notable_actions: None in this chapter; mentioned as a potential healer for Mat

appearances.whereabouts: Guarding the mouth of the alley at The Queen's Blessing
appearances.notable_actions: Stands watch with a spear; warns Rand to watch his back; notes Rand would be useful in a fight
appearances.demeanor: alert, watchful, apparently disinterested but actually very observant

appearances.whereabouts: In an iron cage on a wagon being paraded through Caemlyn to the Palace
appearances.notable_actions: Holds himself upright in the cage; looks over the crowd with a kingly bearing; silences people wherever his gaze falls; laughs at the crowd's hatred as he enters the Palace
appearances.demeanor: proud, defiant, regal, undefeated despite being caged

appearances.whereabouts: In the crowd watching the procession route
appearances.notable_actions: Emerges from the crowd; points directly at Rand with a wordless cry; begins to scuttle across the street toward him; causes Rand to flee
